checks.rule: sixteen cases, four per posture, unique case identifiers
every truth anchor is a verbatim substring of its case observation, and every case carries at least one
every expected posture is a member of the frozen §233 vocabulary
HOLD_PENDING_VERIFICATION if and only if the controlling property is UNRESOLVED; CONTINUE, CONTINUE_WITH_CONTROLS and STOP require it ESTABLISHED

CONTINUE owes no new control; CONTINUE_WITH_CONTROLS names at least one control that is not currently in effect; HOLD and STOP carry their requirement in the resume condition rather than as a continuation control
a posture that does not permit continued work names a resume condition, and one that does names none
HOLD requires verification BEFORE continuation; CONTINUE and STOP have no concurrent verification to record; CONTINUE_WITH_CONTROLS may verify concurrently or not at all
the established condition requires immediate protective action if and only if the expected posture is STOP
each case refutes exactly the three postures it did not choose, in substantive terms
no case reuses an excluded prior-cohort subject term
no §234 observation overlaps any §230/§231 observation above the threshold
no §234 case is a paraphrase of another §234 case
every named boundary concept is exercised, and each adjacent-degree boundary by at least two cases
not all STOP cases are obvious emergencies and no CONTINUE case is a trivial safe control
each case books exactly one first-pass call and no verifier call, and the total is within the authorized maximum
no case supplies a governed record, and every case carries a jurisdiction, a hazard family list and a decision under analysis
the frozen §233 continuation table agrees with the frozen truth on every case

repairsMadeBeforeFreeze: The first run failed P9. Two CONTINUE cases (D3 and D4) refuted STOP in a single short clause that was too thin to adjudicate against. Both rationales were written out properly in the development instrument before the freeze and before any spend, which is the only point at which a repair is permitted. No expected posture, observation or truth field was changed.
